verses.text: Jesus left the temple and was walking away when his disciples came over to show him the temple buildings.
He said to them, “You see all these buildings, right? I’m telling you the truth: not one stone will be left on top of another. They’ll all be torn down.”
While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately. “Tell us, when will these things happen? What will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the age?”
Jesus answered, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.
Many will come using my name and say, ‘I am the Messiah,’ and they’ll lead many astray.
You’ll hear about wars and rumors of wars. Don’t panic. These things must happen, but the end hasn’t come yet.
Nation will fight nation, and kingdom will fight kingdom. There will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in different places.
All of this is only the beginning of birth pains.
“Then people will hand you over to suffering and kill you. All nations will hate you because of my name.
Many will fall away, betray one another, and hate one another.
Many false prophets will appear and lead many astray.
As evil increases, the love of many will grow cold.
But the one who endures to the end will be saved.
This Good News of the Kingdom will be announced throughout the whole world as a witness to all nations. Then the end will come.
“When you see the ‘abomination of desolation’ spoken of through the prophet Daniel standing in the holy place—let the reader understand—
then those in Judea should flee to the mountains.
Anyone on the rooftop shouldn’t go down to get belongings from the house.
Anyone out in the field shouldn’t go back to get a coat.
How terrible it will be for pregnant women and nursing mothers in those days!
Pray that you won’t have to flee in winter or on a Sabbath.
There will be great suffering unlike anything from the beginning of the world until now—and nothing like it will ever happen again.
If those days weren’t cut short, no one would survive. But for the sake of the chosen people, those days will be cut short.
“If anyone tells you then, ‘Look, here is the Messiah!’ or, ‘There he is!’ don’t believe it.
False messiahs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and wonders, trying to lead astray even the chosen people, if possible.
Look, I’ve told you ahead of time.
“So if they tell you, ‘He’s out in the wilderness,’ don’t go. Or if they say, ‘He’s in the inner rooms,’ don’t believe it.
Lightning flashes from the east and is visible in the west. That’s how the coming of the Son of Man will be.
Wherever there’s a dead body, that’s where the vultures gather.
“Right after the suffering of those days, the sun will go dark, the moon won’t give its light, the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of heaven will be shaken.
Then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky. All the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they’ll see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
He’ll send his angels with a loud trumpet call, and they’ll gather his chosen people from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.
“Learn this lesson from the fig tree: when its branches become tender and its leaves come out, you know summer is near.
In the same way, when you see all these things, know that he is near, right at the door.
I’m telling you the truth: this generation won’t pass away until all these things happen.
Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.
“No one knows the day or hour—not even heaven’s angels. Only my Father knows.
The coming of the Son of Man will be like the days of Noah.
Before the flood, people ate and drank, married and were given in marriage, right up until the day Noah entered the ark.
They didn’t realize what was happening until the flood came and swept them all away. That’s how the coming of the Son of Man will be.
Then two men will be working in a field: one will be taken and the other left.
Two women will be grinding grain at a mill: one will be taken and the other left.
So stay alert, because you don’t know what hour your Lord is coming.
Understand this: if the homeowner knew what part of the night the thief was coming, they’d stay awake and wouldn’t let the house be broken into.
So you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour you don’t expect.
“Who is the faithful and wise servant whom the master put in charge of the household, to give everyone their food at the right time?
That servant is blessed if the master comes back and finds them doing their job.
I’m telling you the truth: the master will put that servant in charge of everything he owns.
But if that evil servant says to himself, ‘My master is taking a long time to come,’
and starts beating the other servants and eating and drinking with drunkards,
the master will come on a day the servant doesn’t expect and at an hour they don’t know.
He’ll cut the servant apart and give him a place with the hypocrites, where people weep and grind their teeth.
